description:
From Herodotus to Cassius Dio, ancient historians varied wildly in reliability. Some verified their sources meticulously while others invented fantastical creatures and impossible tales. This ranking examines classical writers, weighing their methods, biases, and accuracy to determine which ancient accounts we can actually trust when reconstructing the distant past today.
